invariants.SPEC-P1-SCOPE-NONDESTRUCTIVE: Phase 1 proves non-destructive backup plus isolated restore only
invariants.SPEC-P1-JOURNAL-CHAIN: upm-system create-only immutable ConfigMap events form a hash chain
invariants.SPEC-P1-JOURNAL-APPEND-ONLY: journal is append-only; no compact or delete in Phase 1
invariants.SPEC-P1-LEASE-NOT-SECURITY: Lease reduces contention and is not a safety control
invariants.SPEC-P1-RESUME-OR-BLOCKED: restart is reconcile or resume; unprovable state is BLOCKED
invariants.SPEC-P1-PLANHASH-BINDINGS: planHash covers identity, facts, actions, risk, budget, and approval policy
invariants.SPEC-P1-APPROVAL-ED25519: ApprovalEnvelope is Ed25519, 15 minutes, single use
invariants.SPEC-P1-TARGET-FENCE: first mutation is a resourceVersion JSON Patch fence before Backup create
invariants.SPEC-P1-ORACLE-AB: restore must contain set A 1..1000 only and exclude set B 1001..1100
invariants.SPEC-P1-EVIDENCE-SIGN: EvidenceManifest is signed by the execution key, not the approver key
invariants.SPEC-P1-NO-COMMENT: authored source and tests have no comment trivia or ignore pragmas
invariants.SPEC-P1-AGENT-NO-PRIVILEGE: agent has no bash, kubectl, kubeconfig, or database admin credentials
